name: Starlink Group 10-49
slot_a_text: B1067 on its 37th flight. Perfect 36 for 36 on landings. Last flew Starlink Group 10-42 47 days ago. Targeting ASOG, 600 km downrange.
slot_b_text: B1067 has flown 36 times over 62 months. Its flights break down as 25 Starlink, two Crew, one O3b, and eight others. Its quickest turnaround was 22 days. No core in the fleet has flown more.
description: A batch of 29 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
